meDescription.text1: I'm a Frontend Developer focused on building modern web and mobile applications. I work primarily with React, Next.js, TypeScript and React Native, with additional experience in Salesforce development using Apex and Lightning Web Components.
meDescription.text2: I have a postgraduate degree in Web and Mobile Applications and continue to develop my skills through hands-on projects and continuous learning.
meDescription.text3: I enjoy turning ideas into clean, responsive and user-focused applications and I'm always looking for new challenges that help me grow as a developer.
